title: Rigidity of maps from a local spectrum to an etale scheme
statement: Let $B$ be a commutative local ring, $\Omega$ a field, and $\beta:B\to\Omega$ a local ring map [def-weil-locally-ringed-space-morphism]. Let $f:X\to S$ be an etale morphism [def-weil-etale-morphism] of schemes [def-pc-scheme]. If $u,v:\operatorname{Spec}B\to X$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum] satisfy $f\circ u=f\circ v$ and $u\circ\operatorname{Spec}\beta=v\circ\operatorname{Spec}\beta$, then $u=v$. Henselianity of $B$, algebraic closure of $\Omega$, and locality of $u$ and $v$ are not assumed.

source.place: Tag 02GE, open diagonal; algebra.tex Tag 08HQ, uniqueness; direct diagonal argument written in Lean by Y2

proof.text: The base equality defines d:Spec B -> X times_S X. The diagonal of an etale morphism is an open immersion (Mathlib FormallyUnramified.isOpenImmersion_diagonal; Stacks 02GE). By the pointed equality and the pullback universal property, Spec beta followed by d equals Spec beta followed by u and the diagonal.

source.place: Tag 02GE, open diagonal; algebra.tex Tag 08HQ, uniqueness; direct diagonal argument written in Lean by Y2

proof.text: Since beta is local, Spec beta sends the closed point of Spec Omega to the closed point of Spec B. Evaluate the preceding equality there: d sends this closed point into the open range of the diagonal. Every point of Spec B generalizes its closed point, so every image under d lies in that range. This uses IsLocalRing.specializes_closedPoint and stability of opens under generization.

source.place: Tag 02GE, open diagonal; algebra.tex Tag 08HQ, uniqueness; direct diagonal argument written in Lean by Y2

proof.text: IsOpenImmersion.lift factors d through the diagonal, whose two projections coincide. Composing lift_fac with the two projections gives l=u and l=v, hence u=v.
